purpose: Evidence-bound retrieval corpus for compiling natural-language portfolio mandates into reviewable constraints. It never produces portfolio weights.
numeric_policy: No template contains a default economic bound or penalty. A compiled numeric lower, upper, or penalty must be copied from the user's request or supported by a value-specific evidence record.

sources.title: ConvexPortfolioSolver executable contract
audited_claims: The current executable solver supports budget, long-only, per-asset, grouped and turnover constraints.
The current executable solver does not establish joint exact-cardinality, industry/style active exposure or tracking-error capability.

sources.title: Index active-risk optimizer executable contract
audited_claims: The implementation consumes benchmark-relative scores and an active-risk covariance representation.
The implementation is not a mixed-integer joint security-selection and weighting solver.

sources.title: Index core-satellite optimizer executable contract
audited_claims: The implementation supplies a benchmark-aware continuous optimization reference path.
It does not prove exact-cardinality MISOCP capability.
